name: Bria Replace Background
description: Replace the image background using a background prompt or background reference image.

action.description: Replace the image background using a background prompt or background reference image.
action.name: br_bgreplace

fast.description: When true, the generation will utilize the fast mode which provides the best balance between speed and quality
fast.title: Fast Generation

original_quality.description: When true, the output image retains the original input image's size; otherwise, the image is scaled to 1 megapixel (1MP) while preserving its aspect ratio.
original_quality.title: Original Quality

refine_prompt.description: When true, an additional logic takes the bg_prompt that was included and adjusts it to achieve optimal results. Built with Meta Llama 3.
refine_prompt.title: Refine Prompt

seed.description: The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time.
seed.title: Seed
